name: deckhands
description: A pixel-art progress band above the prompt with the Claude Code mascot walking along it, and a side panel that turns every subagent into a named crew member (shipwright, navigator, painter, lookout, deckhand) assigned automatically. No cost figures, built for Claude accounts.

band.title: Progress band
band.description: Show the progress band above the prompt. The crew panel works either way. Type /deck-bar in a session to switch it for good.
